articles.title: Zodia Custody CEO Julian Sawyer steps down, becomes adviser
articles.snippet: Sawyer will become a strategic adviser rather than take the helm of Zodia Solutions, as previously announced.

articles.title: Core CPI rose a faster-than-forecast 0.3% in August, setting up possible Fed rate hike
articles.snippet: The August CPI report had taken on outsized importance after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh two weeks ago suggested the central bank may have to act if inflation doesn't soon slow.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital adds institutional access to Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin
articles.snippet: The US federally chartered crypto bank will allow institutional clients to hold, mint, redeem and stake Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin through its custody platform.

articles.title: Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent at $21B valuation: Report
articles.snippet: Nasdaq invested $100 million in Payward as part of its push toward tokenized stock products with round-the-clock trading.

articles.title: Nasdaq Invests $100M in Kraken Parent Payward at $21B Valuation
articles.snippet: Deutsche Börse's April stake implied a $13.3 billion valuation. Five months on, Nasdaq is paying at $21 billion.
